content: (a) The classes of income referred to above are as follows:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part VII. Repealer; Appropriation; Effective Date›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7281.2. Transfers to Public Transportation Assistance Fund
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part VII. Repealer; Appropriation; Effective Date › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7281.2. Transfers to Public Transportation Assistance Fund
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7281.2. Transfers to Public Transportation Assistance Fund (2023)
content:
(a) All revenues received on or after July 1, 1992, from the imposition of the tax
      on periodicals shall be transferred to the Public Transportation Assistance Fund according
      to the formula set forth in subsection (b).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part VII. Repealer; Appropriation; Effective Date›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7281. Appropriation for refunds, etc.
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part VII. Repealer; Appropriation; Effective Date › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7281. Appropriation for refunds, etc.
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7281. Appropriation for refunds, etc. (2023)
content:
So much of the proceeds of the tax imposed by this article as shall be necessary for
   the payment of refunds, enforcement, or administration, under this article, is hereby
   appropriated for such purposes.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part VII. Repealer; Appropriation; Effective Date›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7281.1. Construction of article
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part VII. Repealer; Appropriation; Effective Date › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7281.1. Construction of article
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7281.1. Construction of article (2023)
content:
To the extent that the language of this Article II, is identical to that of equivalent
   provisions in the Tax Act of 1963 for Education,1the said language shall be deemed a reenactment of such identical provisions.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part VII. Repealer; Appropriation; Effective Date›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7282. Effective date
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part VII. Repealer; Appropriation; Effective Date › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7282. Effective date
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7282. Effective date (2023)
content:
The provisions of this article shall take effect immediately, except that clauses
   (k)(4), (m) and (o)(4) of section 201,1clause (c) of section 202,2and clause (17) of section 2043shall take effect July 1, 1971.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part II. Imposition of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7302. Imposition of tax
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part II. Imposition of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7302. Imposition of tax
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7302. Imposition of tax (2023)
content:
(a) Except as provided in subsection (c), every resident individual, estate or trust
      shall be subject to, and shall pay for the privilege of receiving each of the classes
      of income hereinafter enumerated in section 303,1a tax upon each dollar of income received by that resident during that resident's
      taxable year at the rate of three and seven hundredths per cent.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part II. Imposition of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304.2. Pennsylvania ABLE Savings Program tax exemption
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part II. Imposition of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304.2. Pennsylvania ABLE Savings Program tax exemption
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304.2. Pennsylvania ABLE Savings Program tax exemption (2023)
content:
(a) The following shall be exempt from all taxation by the Commonwealth and its political
      subdivisions:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article II-A. Special Situs for Local Sales Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7201-A. Situs of local sales tax on certain leased or rental vehicles or crafts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article II-A. Special Situs for Local Sales Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7201-A. Situs of local sales tax on certain leased or rental vehicles or crafts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7201-A. Situs of local sales tax on certain leased or rental vehicles or crafts (2023)
content:
(a) For purposes of this article only, the lease of a motor vehicle, trailer, semitrailer
      or mobilehome, as defined in 75 Pa.C.S. (relating to vehicles), or of a motorboat,
      aircraft or other similar tangible personal property required under either Federal
      or State laws to be registered or licensed shall be deemed to have been completed
      or used at the address of the lessee.  In the case of a lease, the tax shall be paid by the lessee to the lessor.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part II. Imposition of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7302.1. Rate changes occurring during the taxable year
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part II. Imposition of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7302.1. Rate changes occurring during the taxable year
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7302.1. Rate changes occurring during the taxable year (2023)
content:
Notwithstanding the provisions of section 302, the tax rate to be used for the computation
   of tax for any taxable year where the rate changes during the taxable year shall be
   the monthly weighted average of the rates applicable during the taxable year, regardless
   of when during the taxable year the income is received.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article II-B. Special Taxing Authority›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7201-B. Special taxing authority
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article II-B. Special Taxing Authority › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7201-B. Special taxing authority
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7201-B. Special taxing authority (2023)
content: (a) Imposition of tax.--

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part VII. Repealer; Appropriation; Effective Date›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7280. Repeal
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part VII. Repealer; Appropriation; Effective Date › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7280. Repeal
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7280. Repeal (2023)
content:
The act of March 6, 1956 (P.L. 1228), known as the “Tax Act of 1963 for Education,”1is repealed concurrently with the effective date of the various provisions of this
   article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article II-A. Special Situs for Local Sales Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7202-A. Situs for certain construction materials
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article II-A. Special Situs for Local Sales Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7202-A. Situs for certain construction materials
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7202-A. Situs for certain construction materials (2023)
content:
(a) Notwithstanding the provisions of section 504 of the act of June 5, 1991 (P.L.
      9, No. 6),1known as the “Pennsylvania Intergovernmental Cooperation Authority Act for Cities
      of the First Class,” the sale or use of road construction material, including recycled
      asphalt, recycled concrete, asphalt, concrete and road aggregates, shall be deemed
      to have been consummated at the location of its final destination.  Final destination will be determined by reference to delivery or shipping documents
      relating to such sales.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part II. Imposition of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304. Special tax provisions for poverty
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part II. Imposition of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304. Special tax provisions for poverty
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304. Special tax provisions for poverty (2023)
content:
(a) The General Assembly, in recognition of the powers contained insection 2(b)(ii) of Article VIII of the Constitution of the Commonwealthof Pennsylvania which provides therein for the establishing as a class or classes
      of subjects of taxation the property or privileges of persons who, because of poverty
      are determined to be in need of special tax provisions hereby declares as its legislative
      intent and purpose to implement such power under such constitutional provision by
      establishing special tax provisions as hereinafter provided in this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part I. Definitions›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7301. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part I. Definitions › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7301. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7301. Definitions (2023)
content:
Any reference in this article to the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 shall mean the
      Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (Public Law 99-514,26 U.S.C. § 1 et seq.), as amended to January 1, 1997, unless the reference contains the phrase “as amended”
      and refers to no other date, in which case the reference shall be to the Internal
      Revenue Code of 1986 as it exists as of the time of application of this article.  The following words, terms and phrases when used in this article shall have the
      meaning ascribed to them in this section except where the context clearly indicates
      a different meaning:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article II-A. Special Situs for Local Sales Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7203-A. Situs of local sales tax on mobile telecommunications services
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article II-A. Special Situs for Local Sales Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7203-A. Situs of local sales tax on mobile telecommunications services
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7203-A. Situs of local sales tax on mobile telecommunications services (2023)
content:
(a) For purposes of this article only, the situs of the sales or use of mobile telecommunications
      services which are deemed to be provided to a customer by a home service provider
      under section 117(a) and (b) of the Mobile Telecommunications Sourcing Act (4 U.S.C. § 116) shall be the customer's place of primary use regardless of where the mobile telecommunications
      services originate, terminate or pass through.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part II. Imposition of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304.1. Alternative special tax provision for poverty study
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part II. Imposition of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304.1. Alternative special tax provision for poverty study
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304.1. Alternative special tax provision for poverty study (2023)
content:
(a) The General Assembly directs the Joint State Government Commission to conduct
      or provide for a comprehensive study to determine whether alternative forms of special
      tax provisions for poverty would be more beneficial to persons who, because of poverty,
      are determined to be in need of special tax provisions.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV. Partnerships›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306. Taxability of partners
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV. Partnerships › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306. Taxability of partners
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306. Taxability of partners (2023)
content:
Except as provided under section 306.2,1a partnership as an entity shall not be subject to the tax imposed by this article,
   but the income or gain of a member of a partnership in respect of said partnership
   shall be subject to the tax and the tax shall be imposed on his share, whether or
   not distributed, of the income or gain received by the partnership for its taxable
   year ending within or with the member's taxable year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV. Partnerships›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306.1. Tax treatment determined at partnership level
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV. Partnerships › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306.1. Tax treatment determined at partnership level
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306.1. Tax treatment determined at partnership level (2023)
content:
The classification or character of a partnership item shall be determined at the partnership
   level.  This section shall not prohibit the department from adjusting a partner's return.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV. Partnerships›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306.2. Tax imposed at partnership level
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV. Partnerships › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306.2. Tax imposed at partnership level
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306.2. Tax imposed at partnership level (2023)
content:
(a) A partnership underreporting income by more than one million dollars ($1,000,000)
      for any tax year shall be liable for the tax, excluding interest, penalties or additions
      at the tax rate applicable to the tax year, on the underreported income without regard
      to the tax liability of the partners for the underreported income.  The department shall assess the partnership for the tax on the underreported income.  The department shall not assess the partners for the underreported income or the
      tax thereon;  rather, the partnership shall be required to provide an amended statement
      to each partner as required under section 335(c)(3)1of the partner's pro rata share of the underreported income within ninety days of
      the assessment becoming final.  Nothing in this subsection shall relieve the partners of their tax liability on
      the underreported income.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part III. Estates and Trusts›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7305. Taxability of estates, trusts and their beneficiaries
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part III. Estates and Trusts › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7305. Taxability of estates, trusts and their beneficiaries
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7305. Taxability of estates, trusts and their beneficiaries (2023)
content:
(a) Except as provided in subsection (b), the income of a beneficiary of an estate
      or trust in respect of such estate or trust shall consist of that part of the income
      or gains received by the estate or trust for its taxable year ending within or with
      the beneficiary's taxable year which, under the governing instrument and applicable
      State law, is required to be distributed currently or is in fact paid or credited
      to said beneficiary.  The income or gains of the estate or trust, if any, taxable to such estate or trust
      shall consist of the income or gains received by it which has not been distributed
      or credited to its beneficiaries.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307. Election by small corporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307. Election by small corporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307. Election by small corporation (2023)
content:
Any small corporation may elect not to be taxed as a Pennsylvania S corporation.  Such election requires the consent of one hundred per cent of the outstanding shares
   of the small corporation on the day on which the election is made.  A qualified Subchapter S subsidiary owned by a Pennsylvania S corporation shall
   be treated as a Pennsylvania S corporation whether or not an election has been made
   with respect to such subsidiary.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.5. Termination Year
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.5. Termination Year
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.5. Termination Year (2023)
content:
(a) The portion of the termination year of a Pennsylvania S corporation ending before
      the first day for which the termination is effective shall be treated as a short taxable
      year for which the corporation is a Pennsylvania S corporation.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.1. Manner of making election
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.1. Manner of making election
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.1. Manner of making election (2023)
content: (a) An election made pursuant to section 3071shall be made in such manner as prescribed by the department.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.2. Effective years of election
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.2. Effective years of election
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.2. Effective years of election (2023)
content:
An election made pursuant to section 3071shall be effective for the taxable year for which the election is made and for each
   succeeding taxable year unless revoked or terminated.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.7. Taxable year of a Pennsylvania S corporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.7. Taxable year of a Pennsylvania S corporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.7. Taxable year of a Pennsylvania S corporation (2023)
content:
The taxable year of a Pennsylvania S corporation shall be the same taxable year which
   the corporation uses for Federal income tax purposes.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.8. Income of a Pennsylvania S corporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.8. Income of a Pennsylvania S corporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.8. Income of a Pennsylvania S corporation (2023)
content:
(a) A Pennsylvania S corporation shall not be subject to the tax imposed by this article,
      except as provided under subsection (f), but the shareholders of the Pennsylvania
      S corporation shall be subject to the tax imposed under this article as provided in
      this article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.11. Adjustments to the basis of the stock of shareholders
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.11. Adjustments to the basis of the stock of shareholders
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.11. Adjustments to the basis of the stock of shareholders (2023)
content:
(a) The basis of the stock of any shareholder in a Pennsylvania S corporation shall
      be increased for any period by his share of the corporation's income, including nontaxable
      income, as determined under section 307.9.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.10. Limitation on pass-thru of losses to shareholders
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.10. Limitation on pass-thru of losses to shareholders
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.10. Limitation on pass-thru of losses to shareholders (2023)
content:
(a) The aggregate amount of losses taken into account by a shareholder of a Pennsylvania
      S corporation under section 307.91shall not exceed the sum of the adjusted basis of the shareholder's stock in the
      Pennsylvania S corporation, determined after applying section 307.11(a)2for the taxable year and the shareholder's adjusted basis of any indebtedness of
      the Pennsylvania S corporation to the shareholder, determined before applying section
      307.11(d) for the taxable year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.3. Revocation of election
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.3. Revocation of election
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.3. Revocation of election (2023)
content:
(a) An election under section 3071may be revoked if shareholders holding more than one-half of the shares of stock
      of the corporation on the day on which the revocation is made consent to the revocation.
      The corporation and any successor corporation shall not be eligible to revoke an election
      under this section for any taxable year prior to its fifth taxable year which begins
      after the first taxable year for which an election is effective unless the corporation
      becomes a qualified Subchapter S subsidiary.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.4. Termination by corporation ceasing to be a small corporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.4. Termination by corporation ceasing to be a small corporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.4. Termination by corporation ceasing to be a small corporation (2023)
content: (a) If a corporation ceases to be a small corporation, as defined in section 301(s.2),1the corporation's status as a Pennsylvania S corporation shall terminate.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.12. Distributions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.12. Distributions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.12. Distributions (2023)
content:
(a) A distribution of property by a Pennsylvania S corporation which has no accumulated
      earnings and profits to a shareholder of the corporation shall not be included in
      the shareholder's income to the extent that it does not exceed the shareholder's adjusted
      basis in the stock.  Any amount of the distribution in excess of the adjusted basis in the stock shall
      be treated as a gain from the sale, exchange or other disposition of property.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-B. Other Entities›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.21. Treatment of unincorporated entities with single owners
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-B. Other Entities › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.21. Treatment of unincorporated entities with single owners
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.21. Treatment of unincorporated entities with single owners (2023)
content:
Unless subject to tax under Article IV,1an unincorporated entity that has a single owner shall be disregarded as an entity
   separate from its owner.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.9. Income of Pennsylvania S corporations taxed to shareholders
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.9. Income of Pennsylvania S corporations taxed to shareholders
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.9. Income of Pennsylvania S corporations taxed to shareholders (2023)
content:
(a) Each shareholder of a Pennsylvania S corporation shall take into income such shareholder's
      pro rata share of the income or loss in each applicable class of income received by
      the corporation for its taxable year ending within or with the shareholder's taxable
      year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part V. Nonresident Individuals›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7308. Nonresident individuals; taxable income
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part V. Nonresident Individuals › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7308. Nonresident individuals; taxable income
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7308. Nonresident individuals; taxable income (2023)
content:
The income of a nonresident individual shall be that part of his income derived from
   sources within this Commonwealth as defined in this article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part V. Nonresident Individuals›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7309. Husband and wife

content:

      and are subject to tax under this article is determined on a separately filed return,

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VI. Credits Against Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7312. Tax withheld

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7312. Tax withheld (2023)
content:

   against the tax imposed on him by this article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part V. Nonresident Individuals›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7310. Allocation of income of nonresident
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part V. Nonresident Individuals › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7310. Allocation of income of nonresident
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7310. Allocation of income of nonresident (2023)
content:
Where a nonresident taxpayer earns, receives or acquires income from sources partly
   within and partly without this Commonwealth or engages in a business, trade, profession
   or occupation partly within and partly without this Commonwealth, and, as a result
   thereof or for other reasons that portion of the income derived from or connected
   with sources within this Commonwealth cannot readily or accurately be ascertained,
   the department shall by regulation prescribe uniform rules for apportionment or allocation
   of so much of such taxpayer's income as fairly and equitably represents income, derived
   from sources within this Commonwealth and subject to tax under this article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VI. Credits Against Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7314. Income taxes imposed by other states
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VI. Credits Against Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7314. Income taxes imposed by other states
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7314. Income taxes imposed by other states (2023)
content:
(a) A resident taxpayer before allowance of any credit under section 3121shall be allowed a credit against the tax otherwise due under this article for the
      amount of any income tax, wage tax or tax on or measured by gross or net earned or
      unearned income imposed on him or on a Pennsylvania S corporation in which he is a
      shareholder, to the extent of his pro rata share thereof determined in accordance
      with section 307.9,2by another state with respect to income which is also subject to tax under this article.  For purposes of this subsection, the term“state”shall only include a state of the United States, the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth
      of Puerto Rico and any territory or possession of the United States.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VI. Credits Against Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7313. Tax paid under previous act

   over by a taxpayer as an estimated payment pursuant to repealed Article III of the
   act of March 4, 1971 (Act No. 2),1shall be held as a credit against the tax imposed by this article.

      to the Commonwealth.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7317.1. Information statement for nonemployer payors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7317.1. Information statement for nonemployer payors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7317.1. Information statement for nonemployer payors (2023)
content:
Every payor required to deduct and withhold tax under section 316.21shall furnish to a payee to whom the payor has paid income from sources within this
   Commonwealth during the calendar year a copy of form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC required
   under section 335(f)(1).2The copy of form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC required by this section for each calendar
   year shall be forwarded to the payee on or before March 1 of the year succeeding the
   calendar year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7317. Information statement
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7317. Information statement
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7317. Information statement (2023)
content:
(a) Every employer required to deduct and withhold tax under section 316.1(a)1shall furnish to each such employe to whom the employer has paid compensation during
      the calendar year a written statement in such manner and in such form as may be prescribed
      by the department showing the amount of compensation paid by the employer to the employe,
      the amount deducted and withheld as tax, pursuant to section 316.1(a), and such other
      information as the department shall prescribe.  Each statement required by this section for a calendar year shall be furnished to
      the employe on or before January 31 of the year succeeding such calendar year.  If the employe's employment is terminated before the close of such calendar year,
      the employer, at his option, shall furnish the statement to the employe at any time
      after the termination but no later than January 31 of the year succeeding such calendar
      year.  However, if an employe whose employment is terminated before the close of such calendar
      year requests the employer in writing to furnish him the statement at an earlier time,
      and, if there is no reasonable expectation on the part of both employer and employe
      of further employment during the calendar year, then the employer shall furnish the
      statement to the employe on or before the later of the 30th day after the day of the
      request or the 30th day after the day on which the last payment of wages is made.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7316.1. Requirement of withholding tax
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7316.1. Requirement of withholding tax
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7316.1. Requirement of withholding tax (2023)
content:
(a) Every employer maintaining an office or transacting business within this Commonwealth
      and making payment of compensation (i) to a resident individual, or (ii) to a nonresident
      individual taxpayer performing services on behalf of such employer within this Commonwealth,
      shall deduct and withhold from such compensation for each payroll period a tax computed
      in such manner as to result, so far as practicable, in withholding from the employe's
      compensation during each calendar year an amount substantially equivalent to the tax
      reasonably estimated to be due for such year with respect to such compensation.  The method of determining the amount to be withheld shall be prescribed by regulations
      of the department.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7317.2. Information statement for payees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7317.2. Information statement for payees

content:

   317.11shall file a duplicate of such information return with the payee's State income tax

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7318. Time for filing withholding returns
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7318. Time for filing withholding returns
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7318. Time for filing withholding returns (2023)
content:
(a) Every employer required to deduct and withhold tax under section 316.1(a)1shall file a quarterly withholding return on or before the last day of April, July,
      October and January for the three months ending the last day of March, June, September
      and December.  Such quarterly returns shall be filed with the department at its main office or
      at any branch office which it may designate for filing returns.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7319. Payment of taxes withheld
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7319. Payment of taxes withheld
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7319. Payment of taxes withheld (2023)
content:
(a) Every employer withholding tax under section 316.1(a) shall pay over to the department
      or to a depository designated by it the tax required to be deducted and withheld under
      section 316.1(a).1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7320. Liability for withheld taxes
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7320. Liability for withheld taxes
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7320. Liability for withheld taxes (2023)
content:
Every person required to deduct and withhold tax under section 316.11is hereby made liable for such tax.  For purposes of assessment and collection, any amount required to be withheld and
   paid over to the department and any additions to tax penalties and interest with respect
   thereto, shall be considered the tax of the person.  All taxes deducted and withheld pursuant to section 316.1 or under color of section
   316.1 shall constitute a trust fund for the Commonwealth and shall be enforceable
   against such person, his representative or any other person receiving any part of
   such fund.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7319.1. Payment of taxes withheld for nonemployer payors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7319.1. Payment of taxes withheld for nonemployer payors

   the tax required to be deducted and withheld under section 316.2.  The time for paying over the withheld tax shall be as set forth in section 319(1),
   (2), (3) and (4).2

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7318.1. Time for filing payors' returns
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7318.1. Time for filing payors' returns
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7318.1. Time for filing payors' returns (2023)
content:

   September and December.  The quarterly returns shall be filed with the department in the manner prescribed

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7321.1. Bulk and auction sales and transfers, notice
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7321.1. Bulk and auction sales and transfers, notice
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7321.1. Bulk and auction sales and transfers, notice (2023)
content:
(a) An employer that is liable for filing returns in accordance with the provisions
      of this part and either sells or causes to be sold at auction, or sells or transfers
      in bulk, fifty-one per cent or more of any stock of goods, wares or merchandise of
      any kind, fixtures, machinery, equipment, buildings or real estate held by or on behalf
      of the employer shall be subject to the provisions of section 14031of “The Fiscal Code.”

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7321. Failure to withhold
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7321. Failure to withhold
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7321. Failure to withhold (2023)
content:
If a person fails to deduct and withhold tax as prescribed in this part and thereafter
   the tax against which such tax may be credited is paid, the tax which was required
   to be deducted and withheld shall not be collected from the person, but the person
   shall not be relieved of the liability for any penalty, interest, or additions to
   the tax imposed with respect to such failure to deduct and withhold.
