Every payor required to deduct and withhold tax under section 316.21is hereby made liable for such tax.  For purposes of assessment and collection, any amount required to be withheld and
   paid over to the department and any additions to tax, penalties and interest with
   respect thereto shall be considered the tax of the payor.  All taxes deducted and withheld from payees pursuant to section 316.2 or under color
   of section 316.2 shall constitute a trust fund for the Commonwealth and shall be enforceable
   against such payor, his representative or any other person receiving any part of such
   fund.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII-A. Withholding Tax on Income from Sources Within This Commonwealth›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324. General rule
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII-A. Withholding Tax on Income from Sources Within This Commonwealth › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324. General rule
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324. General rule (2023)
content:
(a) When a partnership, estate, trust or Pennsylvania S corporation receives income
      from sources within this Commonwealth for any taxable year and any portion of the
      income is allocable to a nonresident partner, beneficiary, member or shareholder thereof,
      the partnership, estate, trust or Pennsylvania S corporation shall pay a withholding
      tax under this section at the time and in the manner prescribed by the department;
      however, notwithstanding any other provision of this article, all such withholding
      tax shall be paid over on or before the fifteenth day of the fourth month following
      the end of the taxable year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7322. Designation of third parties to perform acts required of employers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7322. Designation of third parties to perform acts required of employers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7322. Designation of third parties to perform acts required of employers (2023)
content:
In case a fiduciary, agent or other person has the control, receipt, custody or disposal
   of, or pays the compensation of an employe or a group of employes, employed by one
   or more employers, the department is authorized to designate such fiduciary, agent,
   or other person to perform such acts as are required of employers under this article
   as the department may by regulation prescribe.  Except as may be otherwise prescribed by the department, all provisions of this
   article which are applicable to an employer shall be applicable to a fiduciary, agent
   or other person.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7321.2. Payor's failure to withhold
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7321.2. Payor's failure to withhold
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7321.2. Payor's failure to withhold (2023)
content:
If a payor fails to deduct and withhold tax as prescribed under section 316.21and thereafter the tax which may be credited is paid, the tax which was required
   to be deducted and withheld shall not be collected from the payor, but the payor shall
   not be relieved of the liability for any penalty, interest or additions to the tax
   imposed with respect to such failure to deduct and withhold.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII-A. Withholding Tax on Income from Sources Within This Commonwealth›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.1. Amount of withholding tax
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII-A. Withholding Tax on Income from Sources Within This Commonwealth › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.1. Amount of withholding tax
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.1. Amount of withholding tax (2023)
content:
(a) The amount of tax withheld from nonresidents and the amount of the withholding
      tax payable under section 3241shall be equal to the income from sources within this Commonwealth of the partnership,
      association or Pennsylvania S corporation which is allocable to nonresident partners,
      members or shareholders multiplied by the tax rate specified in section 302(b).2

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII. Withholding of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7323. When withholding not required
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII. Withholding of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7323. When withholding not required
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7323. When withholding not required (2023)
content:
Notwithstanding any provision of this code to the contrary, an employer on and after
   January 1, 1975 shall not be required to withhold any tax upon payment of wages to
   an employe if such employe can certify:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII-A. Withholding Tax on Income from Sources Within This Commonwealth›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.3. Liability for tax, interest, penalties and additions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII-A. Withholding Tax on Income from Sources Within This Commonwealth › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.3. Liability for tax, interest, penalties and additions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.3. Liability for tax, interest, penalties and additions (2023)
content:
If a partnership, association or Pennsylvania S corporation fails to pay withholding
   tax as prescribed herein and thereafter such tax is paid, the partnership, association
   or Pennsylvania S corporation shall not be relieved of the liability for any penalty,
   interest or addition as a result of failure to properly withhold such tax.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII-A. Withholding Tax on Income from Sources Within This Commonwealth›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.2. Treatment of nonresident partners, members or shareholders
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII-A. Withholding Tax on Income from Sources Within This Commonwealth › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.2. Treatment of nonresident partners, members or shareholders
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.2. Treatment of nonresident partners, members or shareholders (2023)
content:
(a) Each nonresident partner, member, shareholder or holder of a beneficial interest
      shall be allowed a credit for such partner's, member's, shareholder's or holder of
      a beneficial interest's share of the withholding tax paid by the partnership, association
      or Pennsylvania S corporation.  Such credit shall be allowed for the partner's, member's, shareholder's or holder
      of a beneficial interest's taxable year in which, or with which, the partnership,
      association or Pennsylvania S corporation taxable year (for which such tax was paid)
      ends.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VIII. Estimated Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7325. Declarations of estimated tax
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VIII. Estimated Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7325. Declarations of estimated tax
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7325. Declarations of estimated tax (2023)
content:
(a)(1) Every resident and nonresident individual, trust and estate shall at the time
         hereinafter prescribed make a declaration of his or its estimated tax for the taxable
         year, containing such information as the department may prescribe by regulations,
         if his or its income, other than from income on which tax is withheld under this article,
         can reasonably be expected to exceed the following dollar amount for the applicable
         taxable year:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII-A. Withholding Tax on Income from Sources Within This Commonwealth›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.5. Annual withholding statement
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII-A. Withholding Tax on Income from Sources Within This Commonwealth › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.5. Annual withholding statement
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.5. Annual withholding statement (2023)
content:
(a) Every lessee shall furnish to each lessor an annual statement at such time and
      in such manner as may be prescribed by the department showing the total payments made
      by the lessee to the lessor during the preceding taxable year and showing the amount
      of the tax deducted and withheld from the payments under section 324.4.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VIII. Estimated Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7326. Payments of estimated tax
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VIII. Estimated Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7326. Payments of estimated tax
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7326. Payments of estimated tax (2023)
content:
(a) Subject to the provisions of subsection (j) of section 325,1the estimated tax with respect to which a declaration is required shall be paid as
      follows:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7332. Time and place for filing returns and paying tax
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7332. Time and place for filing returns and paying tax
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7332. Time and place for filing returns and paying tax (2023)
content:
A person required to make and file a return under this article shall, without assessment,
   notice or demand, pay any tax due thereon to the department on or before the date
   fixed for filing such return (determined without regard to any extension of time for
   filing the return).  The department shall prescribe by regulation the place for filing and return, declaration,
   statement, or other document required pursuant to this article and for payment of
   any tax.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7330. Returns and liability
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7330. Returns and liability
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7330. Returns and liability (2023)
content:
(a) On or before the date when the taxpayer's Federal income tax return is due or
      would be due if the taxpayer were required to file a Federal income tax return, under
      the Internal Revenue Code of 1954, a tax return under this article shall be made and
      filed by or for every taxpayer having income for the taxable year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part VII-A. Withholding Tax on Income from Sources Within This Commonwealth›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.4. Withholding on income
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part VII-A. Withholding Tax on Income from Sources Within This Commonwealth › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.4. Withholding on income
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7324.4. Withholding on income (2023)
content:
(a) Every lessee of Pennsylvania real estate who makes a lease payment in the course
      of a trade or business to a nonresident lessor shall withhold Pennsylvania personal
      income tax on rental payments to such nonresident lessor.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7332.1. Electronic payment
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7332.1. Electronic payment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7332.1. Electronic payment (2023)
content:
Any payment in the amount of fifteen thousand dollars ($15,000) or more remitted to
   the department for the tax imposed under this article shall be remitted electronically
   as prescribed by the department.  This section shall not apply to employer withholding payments under Part VII of
   this article1and section 9 of the act of April 9, 1929 (P.L. 343, No. 176),2known as “The Fiscal Code.”

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7330.1. Return of Pennsylvania S corporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7330.1. Return of Pennsylvania S corporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7330.1. Return of Pennsylvania S corporation (2023)
content:
(a) Every Pennsylvania S corporation shall make a return for each taxable year, stating
      specifically all items of gross income and deductions, the names and addresses of
      all persons owning stock in the corporation at any time during the taxable year, the
      number of shares of stock owned by each shareholder at all times during the taxable
      year, the amount of money and other property distributed by the corporation during
      the taxable year to each shareholder, the date of each distribution, each shareholder's
      pro rata share of each item of the corporation for the taxable year and such other
      information as the department may require.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7331. Returns of married individuals, deceased or disabled individuals and fiduciaries
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7331. Returns of married individuals, deceased or disabled individuals and fiduciaries
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7331. Returns of married individuals, deceased or disabled individuals and fiduciaries (2023)
content:
(a) If the income tax liability of husband or wife is determined on a separate return,
      their income tax liabilities under this article shall be separate.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7335. Requirements concerning returns, notices, records and statements
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7335. Requirements concerning returns, notices, records and statements
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7335. Requirements concerning returns, notices, records and statements (2023)
content:
(a) The department may prescribe by regulation for the keeping of records, the content
      and form of returns, declarations, statements and other documents and the filing of
      copies of Federal income tax returns and determinations.  The department may require any person, by regulation or notice served upon such
      person, to make such returns, render such statements, or keep such records, as the
      department may deem sufficient to show whether or not such person is liable for tax
      under this article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7333. Signing of returns and other documents
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7333. Signing of returns and other documents
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7333. Signing of returns and other documents (2023)
content:
(a) Any return other than an estimated return under section 325,1statement or other document required to be made pursuant to this article shall be
      signed in accordance with regulations or instructions prescribed by the department.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7336.1. Procedure for claiming special tax provisions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7336.1. Procedure for claiming special tax provisions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7336.1. Procedure for claiming special tax provisions (2023)
content: The following procedures shall be employed for claiming the special tax provisions:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7340. Procedure for reassessment
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7340. Procedure for reassessment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7340. Procedure for reassessment (2023)
content:
Any taxpayer against whom an assessment is made may petition the department for a
   reassessment pursuant to Article XXVII.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7336. Timely mailing treated as timely filing and payment
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7336. Timely mailing treated as timely filing and payment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7336. Timely mailing treated as timely filing and payment (2023)
content:
Notwithstanding the provisions of any State tax law to the contrary, whenever a report
   or payment of all or any portion of a State tax is required by law to be received
   by the Pennsylvania Department of Revenue or other agency of the Commonwealth on or
   before a day certain, the taxpayer shall be deemed to have complied with such law
   if the letter transmitting the report or payment of such tax which has been received
   by the department is postmarked by the United States Postal Service on or prior to
   the final day on which the payment is to be received.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7334. Extension of time
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7334. Extension of time
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7334. Extension of time (2023)
content:
The department may, upon application, grant a reasonable extension of time for filing
   any return, declaration, statement, or other document required pursuant to this article,
   on such terms and conditions as it may require.  Except for a taxpayer who is outside the United States, no such extension for filing
   any return, declaration, statement or other document, shall exceed six months.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7336.3. Paid tax return preparers; required information on personal income tax returns
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7336.3. Paid tax return preparers; required information on personal income tax returns
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7336.3. Paid tax return preparers; required information on personal income tax returns (2023)
content:
(a) For taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2020, any personal income tax
      return prepared by a paid tax return preparer shall be signed by the paid tax return
      preparer and shall bear the paid tax return preparer's Internal Revenue Service preparer
      tax identification number.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7338. Assessment
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7338. Assessment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7338. Assessment (2023)
content:
(a) The department is authorized and required to make the inquiries, determinations
      and assessments of all taxes imposed by this article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7339. Jeopardy assessments
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7339. Jeopardy assessments
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7339. Jeopardy assessments (2023)
content:
(a) Jeopardy Assessments, Filing and Notice.If the department believes that the assessment or the collection of a deficiency
      will be jeopardized in whole or in part by delay, it may mail or issue notice of its
      finding to the taxpayer, together with a demand for immediate payment of the tax or
      the deficiency declared to be in jeopardy including interest and penalties and additions
      thereto, if any.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7336.2. Proof of eligibility
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part IX. Returns and Payment of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7336.2. Proof of eligibility
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7336.2. Proof of eligibility (2023)
content:
The Department of Revenue shall establish such rules, regulations, schedules or other
   procedures as may be necessary for the submission and establishment of proof of the
   eligibility of persons for the special tax provisions or other matters relating to
   the provisions of this act.  Such procedures may include, but not be limited to, the submission of requisite
   information and certifications upon forms provided by the department, including such
   special tax return or report forms as may be necessary.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7345. Lien for tax
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7345. Lien for tax
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7345. Lien for tax (2023)
content:
(a) If any person liable to pay any tax neglects or refuses to pay the same on the
      date the tax becomes collectible, the amount of such tax, together with any costs
      that may accrue in addition thereto, shall be a lien in favor of the Commonwealth
      against the real and personal property of such person but only after such lien has
      been duly entered and docketed of record by the prothonotary of the county where such
      property is situated.  No prothonotary shall require, as a condition precedent to the entry of such lien,
      the payment of costs incident thereto.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7343. Collection of tax
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7343. Collection of tax
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7343. Collection of tax (2023)
content:
The department shall collect the taxes imposed by this article in the manner provided
   by law for the collection of taxes imposed by the laws of this Commonwealth.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7337. Payment on notice and demand
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7337. Payment on notice and demand
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7337. Payment on notice and demand (2023)
content:
Upon receipt of notice and demand from the department, there shall be paid the amount
   of any tax due under the provisions of this article stated in such notice and demand.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7344. Collection upon failure to request reassessment, review or appeal
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7344. Collection upon failure to request reassessment, review or appeal
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7344. Collection upon failure to request reassessment, review or appeal (2023)
content: The department may collect any tax:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7346. Refund or credit of overpayment
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7346. Refund or credit of overpayment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7346. Refund or credit of overpayment (2023)
content:
(a) In the case of any payment of tax not due under this article, the department may
      credit the amount of such overpayment against any liability in respect of the tax
      imposed by this article on the part of the person who made the overpayment and shall
      refund any balance to such person.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part XI. Miscellaneous Provisions›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7359. Saving clause and limitations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part XI. Miscellaneous Provisions › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7359. Saving clause and limitations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7359. Saving clause and limitations (2023)
content:
(a) Notwithstanding anything contained in any law to the contrary, including but not
      limited to the provisions of the act of August 5, 1932 (Sp.Sess., P.L. 45, No. 45),
      referred to as the Sterling Act,1the validity of any ordinance or part of any ordinance or any resolution or part
      of any resolution, and any amendments or supplements thereto now or hereafter enacted
      or adopted by any political subdivision of this Commonwealth for or relating to the
      imposition, levy or collection of any tax, shall not be affected or impaired by anything
      contained in this article, except as hereinafter provided in subsection (b) of this
      section.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7347. Restrictions on refunds
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7347. Restrictions on refunds
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7347. Restrictions on refunds (2023)
content: A credit or refund may be made under section 346:1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7351. Interest
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7351. Interest
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7351. Interest (2023)
content:
(a) If any amount of tax imposed by Part II of this article1is not paid on or before the last date prescribed for payment, interest on such amount
      at the rate established pursuant to section 806 of the act of April 9, 1929 (P.L.
      343, No. 176), known as “The Fiscal Code,”2shall be paid for the period from such last date to the date paid.  The last date prescribed for payment shall be determined without regard to any extension
      of time for filing the return.  This section shall not apply to any failure to pay estimated tax.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7349. Extension of limitation period
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7349. Extension of limitation period
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7349. Extension of limitation period (2023)
content:
Notwithstanding section 348,1where, before the expiration of the period prescribed therein a taxpayer has consented
   in writing that such period be extended, the amount of tax due may be assessed at
   any time within such extended period.  The period so extended may be further extended by subsequent consents in writing
   made before the expiration of the extended period.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7352. Additions, penalties and fees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7352. Additions, penalties and fees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7352. Additions, penalties and fees (2023)
content:
(a) In case of failure to file any return required under this article on the date
      prescribed therefor, determined with regard to any extension of time for filing, unless
      it is shown that such failure is due to reasonable cause and not due to wilful neglect,
      there shall be added to the amount required to be shown as tax on such return five
      per cent of the amount of such tax if the failure is for not more than one month,
      with an additional five per cent for each additional month or fraction thereof during
      which such failure continues, not exceeding twenty-five per cent, in the aggregate,
      but in no case shall the amount added be less than five dollars ($5).  The amount of tax required to be shown on the return shall, for purposes of computing
      the additions for the first month, be reduced by the amount of any part of the tax
      which is paid on or before the date prescribed for payment of the tax and by the amount
      of any credit against the tax which may be claimed on the return.  The amount of tax required to be shown on the return shall, for purposes of computing
      the addition for any subsequent month, be reduced by the amount of any part of the
      tax which is paid by the beginning of the subsequent month and by the amount of any
      credit against the tax which may be claimed on the return.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7352.1. Abatement of additions or penalties
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7352.1. Abatement of additions or penalties
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7352.1. Abatement of additions or penalties (2023)
content:
Upon the filing of a petition for reassessment or petition for review by a taxpayer
   (other than an employer) as provided by this article, the department may waive or
   abate, in whole or in part, additions or penalties of three hundred dollars ($300)
   or less imposed upon such taxpayer for a taxable year, where the taxpayer has established
   that he acted in good faith with no negligence or intent to defraud.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7350. Limitations on refund or credit
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7350. Limitations on refund or credit
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7350. Limitations on refund or credit (2023)
content: Any application for refund must be filed with the department under Article XXVII1within the time limits of section 3003.1.2

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7352.2. Citation authority
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7352.2. Citation authority
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7352.2. Citation authority (2023)
content:
(a) Notwithstanding any other provision of this act, any person who does any of the
      following commits a summary offense and, upon conviction, shall be subject to the
      fines and penalties imposed under section 208(c):1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7348. Limitations on assessment and collection
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7348. Limitations on assessment and collection
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7348. Limitations on assessment and collection (2023)
content:
(a) The amount of any tax imposed by this article shall be assessed within three years
      after the return is filed.  For the purposes of this subsection and subsection (b), a return filed before the
      last day prescribed for the filing thereof, or before the last day of any extension
      of time for the filing thereof, shall be considered as filed on such last day.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part II. Imposition of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7302.1. Rate changes occurring during the taxable year
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part II. Imposition of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7302.1. Rate changes occurring during the taxable year
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7302.1. Rate changes occurring during the taxable year (2023)
content:
Notwithstanding the provisions of section 302, the tax rate to be used for the computation
   of tax for any taxable year where the rate changes during the taxable year shall be
   the monthly weighted average of the rates applicable during the taxable year, regardless
   of when during the taxable year the income is received.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part II. Imposition of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7302. Imposition of tax
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part II. Imposition of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7302. Imposition of tax
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7302. Imposition of tax (2023)
content:
(a) Except as provided in subsection (c), every resident individual, estate or trust
      shall be subject to, and shall pay for the privilege of receiving each of the classes
      of income hereinafter enumerated in section 303,1a tax upon each dollar of income received by that resident during that resident's
      taxable year at the rate of three and seven hundredths per cent.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part II. Imposition of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7303. Classes of income
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part II. Imposition of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7303. Classes of income
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7303. Classes of income (2023)
content: (a) The classes of income referred to above are as follows:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part I. Definitions›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7301. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part I. Definitions › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7301. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7301. Definitions (2023)
content:
Any reference in this article to the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 shall mean the
      Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (Public Law 99-514,26 U.S.C. § 1 et seq.), as amended to January 1, 1997, unless the reference contains the phrase “as amended”
      and refers to no other date, in which case the reference shall be to the Internal
      Revenue Code of 1986 as it exists as of the time of application of this article.  The following words, terms and phrases when used in this article shall have the
      meaning ascribed to them in this section except where the context clearly indicates
      a different meaning:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part II. Imposition of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304. Special tax provisions for poverty
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part II. Imposition of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304. Special tax provisions for poverty
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304. Special tax provisions for poverty (2023)
content:
(a) The General Assembly, in recognition of the powers contained insection 2(b)(ii) of Article VIII of the Constitution of the Commonwealthof Pennsylvania which provides therein for the establishing as a class or classes
      of subjects of taxation the property or privileges of persons who, because of poverty
      are determined to be in need of special tax provisions hereby declares as its legislative
      intent and purpose to implement such power under such constitutional provision by
      establishing special tax provisions as hereinafter provided in this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part III. Estates and Trusts›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7305. Taxability of estates, trusts and their beneficiaries
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part III. Estates and Trusts › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7305. Taxability of estates, trusts and their beneficiaries
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7305. Taxability of estates, trusts and their beneficiaries (2023)
content:
(a) Except as provided in subsection (b), the income of a beneficiary of an estate
      or trust in respect of such estate or trust shall consist of that part of the income
      or gains received by the estate or trust for its taxable year ending within or with
      the beneficiary's taxable year which, under the governing instrument and applicable
      State law, is required to be distributed currently or is in fact paid or credited
      to said beneficiary.  The income or gains of the estate or trust, if any, taxable to such estate or trust
      shall consist of the income or gains received by it which has not been distributed
      or credited to its beneficiaries.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part II. Imposition of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304.1. Alternative special tax provision for poverty study
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part II. Imposition of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304.1. Alternative special tax provision for poverty study
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304.1. Alternative special tax provision for poverty study (2023)
content:
(a) The General Assembly directs the Joint State Government Commission to conduct
      or provide for a comprehensive study to determine whether alternative forms of special
      tax provisions for poverty would be more beneficial to persons who, because of poverty,
      are determined to be in need of special tax provisions.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV. Partnerships›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306.1. Tax treatment determined at partnership level
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV. Partnerships › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306.1. Tax treatment determined at partnership level
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306.1. Tax treatment determined at partnership level (2023)
content:
The classification or character of a partnership item shall be determined at the partnership
   level.  This section shall not prohibit the department from adjusting a partner's return.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part II. Imposition of Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304.2. Pennsylvania ABLE Savings Program tax exemption
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part II. Imposition of Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304.2. Pennsylvania ABLE Savings Program tax exemption
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7304.2. Pennsylvania ABLE Savings Program tax exemption (2023)
content:
(a) The following shall be exempt from all taxation by the Commonwealth and its political
      subdivisions:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV. Partnerships›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306. Taxability of partners
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV. Partnerships › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306. Taxability of partners
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306. Taxability of partners (2023)
content:
Except as provided under section 306.2,1a partnership as an entity shall not be subject to the tax imposed by this article,
   but the income or gain of a member of a partnership in respect of said partnership
   shall be subject to the tax and the tax shall be imposed on his share, whether or
   not distributed, of the income or gain received by the partnership for its taxable
   year ending within or with the member's taxable year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7357. Appropriation for refunds
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7357. Appropriation for refunds
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7357. Appropriation for refunds (2023)
content:
So much of the proceeds of the tax imposed by this article as shall be necessary for
   the payment of refunds, enforcement, or administration, under this article, is hereby
   appropriated for such purposes.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7353. Crimes
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7353. Crimes
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7353. Crimes (2023)
content:
(a) Any person who wilfully attempts in any manner to evade or defeat any tax imposed
      by this article or the payment thereof shall, in addition to other penalties provided
      by law, be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall, upon conviction, be sentenced to pay
      a fine not exceeding twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000), or to undergo imprisonment
      not exceeding two years, or both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7354. Rules and regulations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7354. Rules and regulations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7354. Rules and regulations (2023)
content:
The department is hereby charged with the enforcement of the provisions of this article,
   and is hereby authorized and empowered to prescribe, adopt, promulgate and enforce
   rules and regulations relating to any matter or thing pertaining to the administration
   and enforcement of the provisions of this article and the collection of taxes imposed
   by this article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.1. Manner of making election
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.1. Manner of making election
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.1. Manner of making election (2023)
content: (a) An election made pursuant to section 3071shall be made in such manner as prescribed by the department.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV. Partnerships›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306.2. Tax imposed at partnership level
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV. Partnerships › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306.2. Tax imposed at partnership level
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7306.2. Tax imposed at partnership level (2023)
content:
(a) A partnership underreporting income by more than one million dollars ($1,000,000)
      for any tax year shall be liable for the tax, excluding interest, penalties or additions
      at the tax rate applicable to the tax year, on the underreported income without regard
      to the tax liability of the partners for the underreported income.  The department shall assess the partnership for the tax on the underreported income.  The department shall not assess the partners for the underreported income or the
      tax thereon;  rather, the partnership shall be required to provide an amended statement
      to each partner as required under section 335(c)(3)1of the partner's pro rata share of the underreported income within ninety days of
      the assessment becoming final.  Nothing in this subsection shall relieve the partners of their tax liability on
      the underreported income.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part XI. Miscellaneous Provisions›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7358. Constitutional construction
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part XI. Miscellaneous Provisions › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7358. Constitutional construction
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7358. Constitutional construction (2023)
content:
In addition to the provisions relating to legislative intent contained in subsection
   (b) of section 303 of this article,1if any word, phrase, clause, sentence, sections or provision of this article is for
   any reason held to be unconstitutional, the decision of the court shall not affect
   or impair any of the remaining provisions of this article.  It is hereby declared as the legislative intent that this article would have been
   adopted had such unconstitutional word, phrase, clause, sentence, section or provision
   thereof not been included herein.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.3. Revocation of election
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.3. Revocation of election
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.3. Revocation of election (2023)
content:
(a) An election under section 3071may be revoked if shareholders holding more than one-half of the shares of stock
      of the corporation on the day on which the revocation is made consent to the revocation.
      The corporation and any successor corporation shall not be eligible to revoke an election
      under this section for any taxable year prior to its fifth taxable year which begins
      after the first taxable year for which an election is effective unless the corporation
      becomes a qualified Subchapter S subsidiary.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part XI. Miscellaneous Provisions›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7360.1. Transfer to Clean Streams Fund
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part XI. Miscellaneous Provisions › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7360.1. Transfer to Clean Streams Fund
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7360.1. Transfer to Clean Streams Fund (2023)
content:
No later than August 1, 2024, and each August 1 thereafter, the sum of fifty million
   dollars ($50,000,000) shall be transferred from the proceeds of the tax imposed under
   this article to the Clean Streams Fund established under section 1712-A.2 of the act
   of April 9, 1929 (P.L. 343, No. 176),1known as “The Fiscal Code.”

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7355. Examination
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7355. Examination
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7355. Examination (2023)
content:
The department, or any agent authorized in writing by it, is hereby authorized to
   examine the books, papers and records of any taxpayer or supposed taxpayer, and to
   require the production of a copy of his return as made to and filed with the Federal
   Government, if one was so made and filed in order to verify the accuracy of any return
   made, or if no return was made, to ascertain and assess the tax imposed by this article.  Every such taxpayer or supposed taxpayer is hereby directed and required to give
   to the department or its duly authorized agent the means, facilities and opportunity
   for such examinations and investigations as are hereby provided and authorized.  The department is hereby authorized to examine any person under oath concerning
   any income which was or should have been returned for taxation, and to this end may
   compel the production of books, papers and records and the attendance of all persons,
   whether as parties or witnesses, whom it believes have knowledge of such income.  The procedure for such hearing or examination shall be the same as that provided
   by “The Fiscal Code” relating to inquisitorial powers of fiscal officers.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.2. Effective years of election
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.2. Effective years of election
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.2. Effective years of election (2023)
content:
An election made pursuant to section 3071shall be effective for the taxable year for which the election is made and for each
   succeeding taxable year unless revoked or terminated.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307. Election by small corporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307. Election by small corporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307. Election by small corporation (2023)
content:
Any small corporation may elect not to be taxed as a Pennsylvania S corporation.  Such election requires the consent of one hundred per cent of the outstanding shares
   of the small corporation on the day on which the election is made.  A qualified Subchapter S subsidiary owned by a Pennsylvania S corporation shall
   be treated as a Pennsylvania S corporation whether or not an election has been made
   with respect to such subsidiary.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.8. Income of a Pennsylvania S corporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.8. Income of a Pennsylvania S corporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.8. Income of a Pennsylvania S corporation (2023)
content:
(a) A Pennsylvania S corporation shall not be subject to the tax imposed by this article,
      except as provided under subsection (f), but the shareholders of the Pennsylvania
      S corporation shall be subject to the tax imposed under this article as provided in
      this article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.9. Income of Pennsylvania S corporations taxed to shareholders
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.9. Income of Pennsylvania S corporations taxed to shareholders
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.9. Income of Pennsylvania S corporations taxed to shareholders (2023)
content:
(a) Each shareholder of a Pennsylvania S corporation shall take into income such shareholder's
      pro rata share of the income or loss in each applicable class of income received by
      the corporation for its taxable year ending within or with the shareholder's taxable
      year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.7. Taxable year of a Pennsylvania S corporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.7. Taxable year of a Pennsylvania S corporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.7. Taxable year of a Pennsylvania S corporation (2023)
content:
The taxable year of a Pennsylvania S corporation shall be the same taxable year which
   the corporation uses for Federal income tax purposes.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part X. Procedure and Administration›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7356. Cooperation with other governmental agencies
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part X. Procedure and Administration › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7356. Cooperation with other governmental agencies
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7356. Cooperation with other governmental agencies (2023)
content:
(a) Notwithstanding the provisions of subsection (f) of section 353,1the department may permit the Commissioner of Internal Revenue of the United States,
      or the proper officer of any political subdivision of this Commonwealth or of any
      other state imposing tax based upon the incomes of individuals, or the authorized
      representative of such officer, to inspect the tax returns of any taxpayer, or may
      furnish to such officer or his authorized representative an abstract of the return
      of income of any taxpayer, or supply him with information concerning any item of income
      contained in any return of any taxpayer.  Such permission shall be granted or such information furnished to such officer or
      his representative only if the statutes of the United States or of such other state,
      as the case may be, grant substantially similar privileges to the proper officer of
      this Commonwealth charged with the administration of the personal income tax law thereof.  An officer or authorized agent of any county imposing a personal property tax shall
      be furnished the following information from such returns upon payment to the department
      of the cost of collecting and reproducing the requested information:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Article III. Personal Income Tax›Part XI. Miscellaneous Provisions›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7361. Effective date
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Article III. Personal Income Tax › Part XI. Miscellaneous Provisions › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7361. Effective date
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7361. Effective date (2023)
content:
Except as hereinafter provided this article shall take effect immediately, except
   the tax shall first apply and be imposed upon income received by or accrued to a taxpayer
   on and after June 1, 1971:  Provided, however, That a taxpayer who filed returns on
   the basis of a fiscal year or who is the beneficiary of an estate or trust or member
   of a partnership which files its returns under this article on the basis of a fiscal
   year, shall be subject to tax for his first taxable period on the portion of his fiscal
   year or of the fiscal year of the estate, trust or partnership which postdates May
   31, 1971, as prescribed by the department by regulations.  Section 10161which provides for additions or penalties to the tax shall not take effect until
   thirty days after the date on which the department has promulgated and issued regulations
   relating to the duties and liabilities imposed on taxpayers under this article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.4. Termination by corporation ceasing to be a small corporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.4. Termination by corporation ceasing to be a small corporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.4. Termination by corporation ceasing to be a small corporation (2023)
content: (a) If a corporation ceases to be a small corporation, as defined in section 301(s.2),1the corporation's status as a Pennsylvania S corporation shall terminate.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.5. Termination Year
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.5. Termination Year
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.5. Termination Year (2023)
content:
(a) The portion of the termination year of a Pennsylvania S corporation ending before
      the first day for which the termination is effective shall be treated as a short taxable
      year for which the corporation is a Pennsylvania S corporation.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.12. Distributions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.12. Distributions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.12. Distributions (2023)
content:
(a) A distribution of property by a Pennsylvania S corporation which has no accumulated
      earnings and profits to a shareholder of the corporation shall not be included in
      the shareholder's income to the extent that it does not exceed the shareholder's adjusted
      basis in the stock.  Any amount of the distribution in excess of the adjusted basis in the stock shall
      be treated as a gain from the sale, exchange or other disposition of property.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-B. Other Entities›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.21. Treatment of unincorporated entities with single owners
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-B. Other Entities › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.21. Treatment of unincorporated entities with single owners
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.21. Treatment of unincorporated entities with single owners (2023)
content:
Unless subject to tax under Article IV,1an unincorporated entity that has a single owner shall be disregarded as an entity
   separate from its owner.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part V. Nonresident Individuals›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7309. Husband and wife
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part V. Nonresident Individuals › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7309. Husband and wife
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7309. Husband and wife (2023)
content:
(a) Separate Return.If the income of husband or wife who are both nonresidents of this Commonwealth
      and are subject to tax under this article is determined on a separately filed return,
      their incomes from sources within this Commonwealth shall be separately determined.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.11. Adjustments to the basis of the stock of shareholders
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.11. Adjustments to the basis of the stock of shareholders
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.11. Adjustments to the basis of the stock of shareholders (2023)
content:
(a) The basis of the stock of any shareholder in a Pennsylvania S corporation shall
      be increased for any period by his share of the corporation's income, including nontaxable
      income, as determined under section 307.9.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part VI. Credits Against Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7312. Tax withheld
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part VI. Credits Against Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7312. Tax withheld
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7312. Tax withheld (2023)
content:
The amount withheld under section 316.11shall be allowed to the taxpayer from whose income the tax was withheld as a credit
   against the tax imposed on him by this article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.10. Limitation on pass-thru of losses to shareholders
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part IV-A. Pennsylvania S Corporations › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.10. Limitation on pass-thru of losses to shareholders
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7307.10. Limitation on pass-thru of losses to shareholders (2023)
content:
(a) The aggregate amount of losses taken into account by a shareholder of a Pennsylvania
      S corporation under section 307.91shall not exceed the sum of the adjusted basis of the shareholder's stock in the
      Pennsylvania S corporation, determined after applying section 307.11(a)2for the taxable year and the shareholder's adjusted basis of any indebtedness of
      the Pennsylvania S corporation to the shareholder, determined before applying section
      307.11(d) for the taxable year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part V. Nonresident Individuals›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7310. Allocation of income of nonresident
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part V. Nonresident Individuals › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7310. Allocation of income of nonresident
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7310. Allocation of income of nonresident (2023)
content:
Where a nonresident taxpayer earns, receives or acquires income from sources partly
   within and partly without this Commonwealth or engages in a business, trade, profession
   or occupation partly within and partly without this Commonwealth, and, as a result
   thereof or for other reasons that portion of the income derived from or connected
   with sources within this Commonwealth cannot readily or accurately be ascertained,
   the department shall by regulation prescribe uniform rules for apportionment or allocation
   of so much of such taxpayer's income as fairly and equitably represents income, derived
   from sources within this Commonwealth and subject to tax under this article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part VI-A. Contributions of Refunds by Checkoff›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7315.1. Definitions

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part VI-A. Contributions of Refunds by Checkoff › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7315.4. Contributions for organ and tissue donation awareness

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part V. Nonresident Individuals›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7308. Nonresident individuals; taxable income
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part V. Nonresident Individuals › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7308. Nonresident individuals; taxable income
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7308. Nonresident individuals; taxable income (2023)
content:
The income of a nonresident individual shall be that part of his income derived from
   sources within this Commonwealth as defined in this article.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part VI. Credits Against Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7314. Income taxes imposed by other states
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part VI. Credits Against Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7314. Income taxes imposed by other states
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7314. Income taxes imposed by other states (2023)
content:
(a) A resident taxpayer before allowance of any credit under section 3121shall be allowed a credit against the tax otherwise due under this article for the
      amount of any income tax, wage tax or tax on or measured by gross or net earned or
      unearned income imposed on him or on a Pennsylvania S corporation in which he is a
      shareholder, to the extent of his pro rata share thereof determined in accordance
      with section 307.9,2by another state with respect to income which is also subject to tax under this article.  For purposes of this subsection, the term“state”shall only include a state of the United States, the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth
      of Puerto Rico and any territory or possession of the United States.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part VI-A. Contributions of Refunds by Checkoff›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7315.3. Contributions for wild resource conservation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part VI-A. Contributions of Refunds by Checkoff › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7315.3. Contributions for wild resource conservation

      amount desired to the Wild Resource Conservation Fund established under section 5

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs›Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971›Part VI. Credits Against Tax›PA ST 72 P.S. § 7313. Tax paid under previous act
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part VI. Credits Against Tax › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7313. Tax paid under previous act
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7313. Tax paid under previous act (2023)
content:
The amount of tax withheld from an employe and paid over to the Commonwealth or paid
   over by a taxpayer as an estimated payment pursuant to repealed Article III of the
   act of March 4, 1971 (Act No. 2),1shall be held as a credit against the tax imposed by this article.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 72 P.S. Taxation and Fiscal Affairs › Chapter 5. Tax Reform Code of 1971 › Part VI-A. Contributions of Refunds by Checkoff › PA ST 72 P.S. § 7315.8. Contributions for military family relief assistance
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 72 P.S. § 7315.8. Contributions for military family relief assistance (2023)
content:
(a) Beginning with taxable years ending after December 31, 2004, the department shall
      provide a space on the Pennsylvania individual income tax return form whereby an individual
      may contribute to a fund for military family relief assistance.  Persons may do so by stating the amount of the contribution, not less than one dollar
      ($1), on the return and that the contribution will reduce the taxpayer's refund.
